title: Pearlink
description: Adds Pearlink blocks, which allow the user to teleport between them.
body:
Pearlink

  A Fabric mod that adds a single craftable block turning any item into a teleport destination. Place two
  Pearlink Blocks, key them with the same item, and step on one to instantly arrive at the other — a lightweight,
  item-dialed teleporter network that replaces nether highways and rail tunnels.

  ---
  Additional Info

  - Activation: Step-on trigger with a 5-second per-player cooldown
  - Safety: Destination is checked for obstructions; refuses to drop you into solid blocks
  - Automation: Hopper-compatible on all sides — swap keys with redstone or item pipes
  - Lockable: Each block supports a locked state to protect shared networks
  - Crafting: Mid-game recipe using obsidian, amethyst shards, and an ender pearl
  - Creative tab: Functional Blocks
  - Advancement: Slipgate Surfer for your first teleport
